citation.verbatim: Monster accepted for purchase a total of 56,603,773 shares of its common stock... at the final purchase price of $53.00 per share... shares were accepted for purchase on a pro rata basis, except for tenders of "odd lots," which will be accepted in full. Monster has been informed by the depositary that the final proration factor for the tender offer is approximately 47.18%.

D1.decision: Apply the final 47.18% proration to the 10,000 shares validly tendered by expiration because the account is not an odd-lot holder. Confirm 5,282 residual shares. Gross proceeds of $250,054 are determined, but the store does not establish a payment date; the receivable tool rejects an unspecified pay_date, so assignment of the payment date and release of the gross receivable remain held rather than using the unsupported June 10 announcement date. Do not submit a post-expiration election. Fees and net proceeds are separately held pending the missing Letter of Transmittal.
